tool.name: DESeq2 differential expression
tool.description: pairwise differential expression from a raw count matrix

param.name: counts
param.label: Raw count matrix
param.help: Tab-separated matrix of raw (un-normalized) integer read counts: first column gene identifiers, one further column per sample. Do not supply TPM/FPKM or otherwise normalized values.

param.name: coldata
param.label: Sample table
param.help: Tab-separated sample annotation: first column sample identifiers matching the count matrix column names, one further column per covariate (e.g. condition, batch). Every variable used in the design formula must be a column of this table.

param.name: design
param.label: Design formula
param.help: R formula over sample table columns. Control for covariates by putting them first; the tested variable comes last (e.g. "~ batch + condition").

param.name: contrast_factor
param.label: Factor to test
param.help: Sample table column containing the tested condition.

param.name: contrast_numerator
param.label: Treatment level (numerator)
param.help: Level of the tested factor whose effect is reported.

param.name: contrast_denominator
param.label: Reference level (denominator)
param.help: Baseline level the treatment is compared against.

param.name: alpha
param.label: FDR threshold (alpha)
param.help: Significance cutoff used to optimize independent filtering. Set it to the adjusted p-value threshold you will actually use.

param.name: shrinkage
param.label: Log2 fold change shrinkage
param.help: Shrinkage estimator applied to the reported log2 fold changes; "apeglm" is the recommended default, "none" reports maximum likelihood estimates.

param.name: prefilter
param.label: Pre-filter low-count genes
param.help: Remove genes with insufficient counts before testing.

param.name: prefilter_min_samples
param.label: Pre-filter minimum samples
param.help: Keep genes with at least the minimum count in at least this many samples. 0 (default) means automatic: the size of the smallest group of the tested factor.

tool.help:
**DESeq2 differential expression**
Runs the canonical DESeq2 workflow on a raw count matrix: size factor and dispersion estimation, negative-binomial GLM fitting and a Wald test for one pairwise contrast, with optional independent pre-filtering and log2-fold-change shrinkage. Produces the per-gene results table, the median-of-ratios normalized counts, and an MA plot.
**Inputs**
- *Raw count matrix* (tsv): Tab-separated matrix of raw (un-normalized) integer read counts: first column gene identifiers, one further column per sample. Do not supply TPM/FPKM or otherwise normalized values.
- *Sample table* (tsv): Tab-separated sample annotation: first column sample identifiers matching the count matrix column names, one further column per covariate (e.g. condition, batch). Every variable used in the design formula must be a column of this table.
**Outputs**
- *Differential expression results* (tsv): Per-gene table (baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj, and stat for unshrunken results), ordered by adjusted p-value.
- *Normalized counts* (tsv): Median-of-ratios normalized counts for all retained genes. - *MA plot* (pdf):
